safeScore.interpretation: The final SAFE-A head remains strongly separated between the two consumed diagnostic groups. No threshold or preprocessing change was made.

embeddingDistances.conclusion: Cloudflare FLUX.1 is moved toward the real-control embedding space, not merely compressed at the final classifier head. This supports a material provider/runtime/domain shift, while not identifying its cause.

independentCrossCheck.method: Recompute group centroids and public/cloudflare cosine distances from the frozen NPZ vectors and sample-id order, then compare to representation-analysis.json.

limits: The Cloudflare set is consumed diagnostic data, not an unbiased holdout.
The comparison does not establish whether provider encoding, generation runtime, or upstream generator variation caused the shift.
No FLUX.2 bytes, pixels, features, embeddings, or provider calls were used.
